For typical two-track stations a value of 1.2 to 1.4 seconds is appropriate. For very large or high ceiling spaces and for multi-track stations a value of 1.4 to 1.6 seconds is satisfactory. Such design criteria are sufficient and appropriate to control noise, reduce speech interference and should provide for good intelligiblity of public address system announcements and patron voice communication.
- Ancillary Equipment Noise
Station ventilation system noise is probably the simplest to control by selection of fan locations and acoustical design of fan installations and ducts. Escalators and elevator equipment also produce noise which may affect station public space environment. Since the ventilation system and other mechanical equipment noise may be regarded as steady-state during lengthy periods of operation, the design guidelines noise level limit for station platforms should be 55 dBA except under emergency conditions. Escalator noise should be limited to 55 dBA maximum at the entrance combs. Ventilation system noise in station attendants' booths should be limited to 50 dBA.
